import numpy as np
def evaluate(p=.6,g=.9,a=.25):
    P=np.array([[1-a,a],[1.,0.]])
    r=np.array([(1-a)*(10*p-4)-a,6.])
    return np.linalg.solve(np.eye(2)-g*P,r)
def action_values(v,p=.6,g=.9):
    return np.array([10*p-4+g*v[0],-1+g*v[1]])

import numpy as np
p=.6;g=.9;a=.25
P=np.array([[1-a,a],[1.,0.]])
r=np.array([(1-a)*(10*p-4)-a,6.])
def backup(v,optimal=True):
    return np.array([max(10*p-4+g*v[0],-1+g*v[1]),6+g*v[0]]) if optimal else r+g*P@v
exact_policy=np.linalg.solve(np.eye(2)-g*P,r)
exact_opt=np.array([(-1+6*g)/(1-g*g),6+g*(-1+6*g)/(1-g*g)])
代码 1for optimal in [False,True]:
    v=np.zeros(2);target=exact_opt if optimal else exact_policy
    for k in range(81):
        if k in [0,1,2,3,20,80]:
            delta=np.max(np.abs(backup(v,optimal)-v))
            print('optimal',optimal,'k',k,'V',v,'residual',delta,'bound',delta/(1-g),'error',np.max(np.abs(v-target)))
        v=backup(v,optimal)
print('exercise bound',.01/(1-.9))
